operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: IDF Kills Mohammed Sinwar, Hamas Gaza Military Commander, in Tunnel Beneath European Hospital on Day 945
heroSubtitle: In the most significant Hamas leadership strike since Yahya Sinwar's death in October 2024, IDF and Shin Bet forces killed Mohammed Sinwar — Hamas's top military commander for the Gaza Strip and brother of Yahya Sinwar — on May 13, 2026 (Day 945) in an airstrike on a command tunnel 8 meters beneath the EU-funded Gaza European Hospital compound in Khan Yunis. Also killed in the same tunnel: Muhammad Shabana (Rafah Brigade commander) and Mahdi Quara (South Khan Yunis Battalion commander). Simultaneously, the IDF expanded its territorial control from the Yellow Line to a new Orange Line approved by the Board of Peace, adding 34 square kilometers and bringing Israeli-controlled territory to approximately 64% of the Gaza Strip. PM Netanyahu met with Board of Peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov in Jerusalem — described as 'positive and substantive' — with both reaffirming commitment to Trump's 20-point postwar Gaza plan. This is Day 3 of the renewed military campaign authorized by Israel's security cabinet on May 10, 2026, following the 212-day October 2025 ceasefire. Cumulative deaths since the October 2025 ceasefire: 856+ killed, 2,463+ wounded. Total Gaza death toll: approximately 72,740+ killed since October 7, 2023.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Shin Bet, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, WAFA, IMEMC, JNS, Jerusalem Post, Middle East Monitor, Israel Hayom, and UN DPPA. Gaza death toll: 72,740+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023 (IMEMC/WAFA, May 13, 2026). 856+ killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire (2,463+ wounded). IDF security cabinet authorized war resumption May 10, 2026. Day 1 (May 11): 188th Brigade and Yahalom unit destroyed four Hamas tunnel structures in southern Gaza; Kfir Brigade destroyed 2 tunnel routes in central Gaza. Day 2 (May 12): Kfir Brigade kills Nukhba operatives via IAF airstrike; 4 Palestinians killed. Day 3 (May 13): Mohammed Sinwar + Muhammad Shabana + Mahdi Quara killed in European Hospital tunnel; IDF Orange Line expansion adds 34 sq km (64% of Gaza). Netanyahu-Mladenov meeting Jerusalem. 14,222 bodies remain under rubble. Only 17 of 36 hospitals partially functional. 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, under 10% funded. Day 945 of war.
